format: html

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
```


```{r}
one <- '{"Monday":94,"Tuesday":76,"Wednesday":89,"Thursday":106,"Friday":130,"Saturday":128,"Sunday":58}'

two <- '{"Monday":18,"Tuesday":16,"Wednesday":14,"Thursday":27,"Friday":26,"Saturday":36,"Sunday":20}'

three <- '{"Monday":0,"Tuesday":0,"Wednesday":1,"Thursday":0,"Friday":0,"Saturday":1,"Sunday":0}'
```


```{r}
table_maker <- function(extractor) {
  
  days <- str_extract_all(
    extractor,
    "Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday"
  )[[1]]
  
  amount <- str_extract_all(
    extractor,
    "\\d+"
  )[[1]] %>%
    as.integer()
  
  tibble(
    days = days,
    amount = amount
  )
}
```


```{r}
highest_day <- function(extractor) {
  
  df <- table_maker(extractor)
  
  df %>%
    filter(amount == max(amount)) %>%
    pull(days) %>%
    paste(collapse = ", ")
}
```


```{r}
table_maker(one)
highest_day(one)
```

```{r}
table_maker(two)
highest_day(two)
```

```{r}
table_maker(three)
highest_day(three)
```
